summary: Everyone knows Mario, Pokémon, Call of Duty, GTA and Minecraft; the last spots (Resident Evil, Final Fantasy) hide among famous near misses like The Sims, Zelda and Sonic that eat lives fast. Plays great as Blitz too.
reasons: Casual 8/10 (Mario, Tetris, Pokémon, Call of Duty, GTA, Minecraft, FIFA, Assassin's Creed); lives went on Zelda #15, Sonic #18, Halo #35, The Sims #13 and Wii Sports #11, the last on the final guess. The fan also stopped at 8, out of lives on The Sims, Sonic, Lego, Wii and Need for Speed: #9 to #18 span only 218 to 140 million, so the tail is partly a lottery. Estimated crowd average about 6.

Top 10 matches the source exactly and is current (Resident Evil 218 million as of October 2026); #10 and #11 don't tie (215 vs 204). Common forms work: cod, gta 5, ea fc, biohazard, ff, mario kart, luigi. Fortnite and other free-to-play games are free misses.
Blitz is deep: 21 of 26 names scored in 90 s (17 of the first 20). Pac-Man, Crash Bandicoot and Guitar Hero are accepted but score nothing, because the source table stops at 50 million.
fixes: Mario (#1): add 'Super Mario Bros', 'Super Mario Bros.', 'Mario Bros' and 'Mario Bros.' as aliases. 'super mario bros' and 'mario bros' are not recognized now ('super mario' and 'mario brothers' are).

Final Fantasy (#10): drop 'Compilation of Final Fantasy VII' from the unranked pool (it is part of the series) and add 'Final Fantasy VII' and 'FF7' as aliases; 'final fantasy 7' and 'final fantasy vii' currently cost a life. Drop the other sub-series entries too: 'Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles', 'Fabula Nova Crystallis Final Fantasy'.

Junk redirect aliases on the top 10. Mario: characters, enemies, places and the film ('Kamek the Magikoopa', 'Toadsworth', 'Koopa kid', 'Fire Bro', 'Toad Town', 'Professor E. Gadd', 'Lord Fawful', 'FawfuI', 'Cheep-Cheep', 'Bob-Omb', 'Dry Bones', 'Buzzy Beetle', 'Snifit', 'Lumalee', 'Bloober', 'Ignatius Koopa', 'Petey Piranha', 'Peach's Castle', 'Mushroom Kingdom', 'Super Mario Bros film', 'SMB Film', 'Mario Takes America' and the like). Pokémon: mechanics and characters ('Pokémon moves', 'Pokémon natures', 'Pokémon breeding', 'Pokémon evolution', 'Gym Leader', 'Gym Badges', 'Pokéball', 'Giovani', 'Professor Odamaki', 'Yukinari Ôkido-Hakase', 'Pokémon crime syndicates'). Resident Evil: every 'Biohazard ... Soundtrack' and '... Orchestra' redirect, 'Resident Evil list of books', 'The Umbrella Conspiracy', 'Arklay Forrest', 'Arklay Mountains', 'Raccoon City Outbreak', 'Operation Bacillus Terminate', 'Bio-Organic Weapon', 'Drain Demios'. Assassin's Creed: 'Abstergo Industries', 'Creed's Assassin'. Tetris: 'L-BIock'. GTA: 'Lists of Grand Theft Auto characters'. FIFA: 'FIFA leagues'.

Minor, free misses on plain names of top-10 answers: 'grand theft auto v' (while 'gta v' works), 'gta 6' / 'gta vi', 'resident evil 4' / 're4', 'pokemon go'. Add as aliases where the numbered-title rule allows.
